meta.name: academic-plotting
meta.description: Generates publication-quality figures for ML papers from research context. Given a paper section or description, extracts system components and relationships to generate architecture diagrams via Gemini. Given experiment results or data, auto-selects chart type and generates data-driven figures via matplotlib/seaborn. Use when creating any figure for a conference paper.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为机器学习论文生成出版级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在撰写机器学习论文并需要高质量图表
copy.tagline_en: Generate publication-quality figures for ML papers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing a machine learning paper and need high-quality figures

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能根据论文文字或实验数据自动生成两种图:架构/流程图用 Gemini 生成,数值型图表(柱状图、折线图、热图等)用 matplotlib/seaborn 绘制。它会先分析上下文,自动选图表类型,并把论文自己的方法用单独颜色突出。
howto.when: 当用户要求为会议论文制作图片,并提供论文段落、系统描述或实验数据(如 CSV、结果表格)时触发;笼统要求画概览图时也会从上下文提取内容。

say.text: 把这段方法部分画成架构图,用现代极简风格。
say.note: 会触发 Gemini 生成架构图的工作流。

say.text: 根据这些实验数据画一张分组柱状图,突出我们的方法。
say.note: 会自动选图表类型并用 matplotlib 绘制。

say.text: 用草图风格给这个系统流程画一张示意图。
say.note: 会采用手绘草图视觉风格生成。

howto.what_en: Claude generates two figure types from your paper text or data: Gemini creates architecture/flow diagrams; matplotlib/seaborn create data charts (bar, line, heatmap). It auto-selects chart type and highlights the paper's own method in a distinct color.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a conference-paper figure, providing paper sections, system descriptions, or experiment data (CSV, results). Vague requests like 'make an overview figure' also trigger it via context inference.

say_en.text: Turn this method section into an architecture diagram in modern minimal style.
Create a grouped bar chart from these experiment results, highlight our method.
say_en.note: Auto-selects chart type and draws with matplotlib.

say_en.text: Draw a sketch-style flow diagram for this system pipeline.
